title: Agent Workflow Runtime charter, authority matrix, and admission rule
invariants: The runtime translates and enforces family contracts; it cannot manufacture authority-owned decisions.
An admission result is valid only for its exact task revision and canonical specification digest.
Evidence identifiers and digests are single-use within an admission record.
Public projections contain no credentials, private paths, prompts, transcripts, host identifiers, or personal data.

compatibility.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, no trailing newline

limitations: This checker validates contract shape, bindings, uniqueness, and privacy-safe projections; it does not prove implementation refinement or process isolation.
A digest proves bytes were bound, not that the referenced task or evidence is truthful; Coordinator and AWQ remain authoritative.
The checker has no network, provider, GitHub, hosted-CI, credential, or runtime connection and cannot establish remote success.
follow_up: Implement adapters and supervisor transitions under separate ARs with positive and hostile tests.
Integrate Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, and UI clients only through their authoritative contracts.
